parameters.name: template
parameters.value: monospace-like text onto a fixed-resolution canvas

parameters.name: order
parameters.value: left-to-right within each row, then top-to-bottom across rows

parameters.name: lexical_mapping
parameters.value: lowercase letters converted to uppercase; no auxiliary markers

decisions.chain_element: Render the genomic sequence into a structured multi-page DNA document

evidence.quote: We rasterize S as monospace-like text onto a fixed-resolution canvas, writing nucleotides row-by-row (left-to-right within each row, then top-to-bottom across rows).

decisions.rationale: R6: rendering sequence data into a structured textual document is serialize.

decisions.chain_element: Partition each page into non-overlapping 16 × 16 patches

evidence.quote: We partition each page into non-overlapping 16 × 16 patches and encode them with the SAM-Conv-CLIP-L visual front-end.

decisions.rationale: R6: dividing each page into patches while retaining all patches is partition.

decisions.chain_element: Encode the patches with the SAM-Conv-CLIP-L visual front-end

evidence.quote: Following DeepSeekOCR (Wei et al., 2025), E θ adopts the SAM-Conv-CLIP-L visual front-end

decisions.rationale: R3: the named visual front-end is a learned module boundary.

decisions.chain_element: Apply the learned projector Πθ

evidence.quote: We then apply a learned projector Π θ to align the resulting features to the decoder width d

decisions.rationale: R3: learned projector → project.

decisions.chain_element: Aggregate pages with the multi-page fusion module Fθ

evidence.quote: We instantiate F θ as a multi-head self-attention module with one attention layer and 20 heads, followed by a mean reduction over the page dimension, yielding a compact token sequence invariant to the number of pages.

decisions.rationale: R3: the named multi-page fusion module remains a learned-module boundary.
decisions.uncertainty: The paper states self-attention and mean reduction inside Fθ, but this chain element names the fusion module itself; its internals are therefore not emitted as separate calls.
